items.title: Optional mercy limit in Duel
items.text:
Optional mercy limit in Duel
People often go on about how there should be a mercy limit, like a 10 frag difference. I hate the idea of a forced mercy limit, but I can see why people like it. So why not make some sort of optional surrender button, that only appears after being down a certain amount of frags?

Might be worth trying out.

That would require a lot of playtesting tho I think. Probably not easy to get the exact amount of time right. Comebacks towards the end would be kinda hard tho, wouldnt they? If a player is only 2 frags down  towards the end of the game, that's a lot of missing time.
Oh yeah, forgot about the confirmation frag idea. That should help with leading players being too passive.
OwO

>  At least with round based there is a chance for the opponent to get back into it

This is my main problem. Getting back and staying in control takes so much more skill in other Quake titles. 

Also as soon as you see the players exchanging frags and getting into a flow, the round is over. 

I used to love watching Quake back then. Round format ruined it for me. 

I'm sure Quake esports would have been more popular with time limit duels, but not enough to make a difference I guess.

Have you ever watched other Quake Duels when the tournament scene was active? Because it's a big difference watching a couple of old vods and never seen anything live.

I loved the old format. Never got into the round based format. Rounds are so boring to watch. Just plus forward, retarded all ins, map control is not nearly as important, coming back from a deficit was a real skill and as soon as the match gets interesting, the round ends.

Its just like the rest of QC. It's a cool idea but thats it. Champions should have been a game mode, not the main feature and round based duel would have been the 1v1 mode for it. Would have been perfect.

> do you think that is because of max stack being lower, the use of abilities and weapon damage being higher in QC?

Yes, that and 30/30 timings. I don't have any problems timing in QC, but it's really hard for me in QL. And I mean you don't have to keep control for very long. Taking bad fights is so much more forgiving, since the round resets anyway. In the old Quake titles you ofc have to actually fight back, not just die 3 times in order to reset control.
Yeah, the map design is great. The maps look great. Not sure how you can say graphics are one of the best you've seen. Game looks mediocre.
